files.role: 63 parent components; units_snapshot 116 targets with rid/uid/ref_cA/ref_cB
original-run C_local raw outputs; only arm=C_local/kind=call records used
existing SHA-256 receipts for the files above (run/ entries)

parse_rule.ledger_selection: records with arm=='C_local' and kind=='call', cell==f'{cid}|C_local|{side}', exactly one per cell
parse_rule.normalization: strip whitespace; strip one trailing ASCII '.' if present (observed original-run rule, 9/126 cells)
parse_rule.invalid_if: label not in classes, or UNKNOWN, or expected rid line missing, or unexpected rid line present, or record count != 1
parse_rule.three_way_requirement: raw_sha and prompt_sha match seal C_local_cells; re-parsed labels match seal C_local[rid][side]; unresolved cells go to unresolved list and trigger INPUT_UNRESOLVED/PARTIAL

readings.weak_structural_relation: valid AB/BA rows are mutual swaps; AA/BB rows same-class; construction check only, certifies composition implementation; invalid labels never pass
readings.relation_change_pass: both sides valid AND pA != pB AND weak structural relation holds; does NOT check prediction == reference
readings.pair_correct: both sides valid AND pA==gA AND pB==gB; AB and BA listed separately and must be identical; AA/BB equal respective single-side correctness

relation_pass_but_wrong.status: diagnostic frequency of this frozen cache; not a model-policy false-accept rate; no extrapolation

aggregation.parent_equal_weight: mean over 63 components of per-component mean over that component's frozen targets

definitions.OTHER_LEGAL_WRONG_DIFF: valid AND pA!=pB AND (pA,pB)!=(gB,gA) AND not fully correct

mapping_check_2026_10_01: 232/232 side labels are legal class values
known_information.usage_limit: mapping cross-check only; never subtracted, squared, or substituted for K

result_rules.REUSE_OBSERVED_IN_SCOPE: inputs and mapping reliable AND K>=1 AND pointer to original outputs exists
result_rules.INPUT_UNRESOLVED: version/mapping/parse not reliably verifiable; stop dependent statistics

claims_boundary: none of the three statuses certifies real direction mechanism, object binding, event gold, geographic generalization, or new-method performance; retrospective reuse is never an independent confirmation
week2_r1_not_transplanted: week-2 R1 '100% correct under full ground truth' is not a real-model reception condition
